name: work
description: Paid employment, freelance jobs, client projects, meetings, and business tasks.

name: study & learning
description: Classes, courses, tutorials, skill-building, reading for career or school, and portfolio or learning projects.

name: chores
description: Housework inside the home: cleaning, laundry, doing dishes, tidying, and home maintenance.

name: errands
description: Tasks and trips outside the home: grocery shopping, pharmacy, post office, dry cleaners, bank, and returns.

name: meals
description: Eating breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, and dining out alone or with others. Meal preparation is chores.

name: sleep
description: Sleeping at night, taking naps, and resting in bed trying to fall asleep.

name: exercise
description: Workouts, gym sessions, running, fitness walks, sports, yoga, and stretching.

name: personal care
description: Daily hygiene and self-care: showering, skincare, brushing teeth, grooming, haircuts, and spa treatments.

name: healthcare
description: Medical and dental appointments, therapy, taking medication, and pharmacy visits for prescriptions.

name: social
description: Time spent connecting with friends, family, or partners: visits, calls, messaging, video chats, parties, and hangouts.

name: entertainment
description: Watching TV, movies, YouTube, listening to podcasts or music, playing video games, attending concerts or shows.

name: screen time
description: Casual phone use, scrolling social media feeds, and browsing the web.

name: hobbies & creative
description: Crafts, playing an instrument, music practice, painting, creative writing, gardening, or personal creative projects.

name: reading
description: Reading books, literature, essays, or articles for leisure and pleasure.

name: admin
description: Personal logistics: paying bills, banking, taxes, filing forms, scheduling appointments, and inbox triage.

name: shopping
description: Browsing or purchasing items (clothing, household goods, online orders) other than grocery errands.

name: vacation
description: Trips, holidays, and travel away from home. Overrides ordinary daily categories while traveling.
